verdict.rationale: Langfuse's evaluation docs explicitly list Annotation Queues for manually reviewing and rating traces, with Scores via UI. They also say human annotations can be combined with LLM-as-a-Judge and API/SDK evaluations, which directly matches routing outputs to human review and labeling. The evidence is only a repeated one-line table entry, though, with no detail on how items reach a queue. Missing for 10: documentation of how outputs are routed into queues (manual selection, rules, or API/SDK), detail on labeling and score configuration within queues, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the annotation queue workflow.
